name: Heart of Wonder: The Dark Mines
source:
Lucille has been slowly recovering after surviving a traumatic event. One day while in the care of her guardian, they discover the mines they've been working in contain older horrors than they know. 

[From [url=https://thecrimsondm-rated-t.itch.io/heart-of-wonder-the-mines]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
露西尔在经历了一次创伤事件后正在慢慢康复。有一天，在她的监护人的照顾下，他们发现他们一直在工作的矿井里藏着比他们所知更古老的恐怖物。

[来自[url=https://thecrimsondm-rated-t.itch.io/heart-of-wonder-the-mines]itch.io[/url]]
